title: Airspace Monitoring Case of a Power Plant in Pakistan
title_en: Airspace Monitoring Case of a Power Plant in Pakistan
description:
2024 Airspace Monitoring Case of a Power Plant in Pakistan
Equipment Used:
Stationary Spectrum Detection Equipment
Navigation-Signal Analysis Equipment
Command and Control Platform Software
Project Introduction:
In 2024, this power-plant project delivered a low-altitude airspace monitoring plan for the facility perimeter and core operation zones. Stationary spectrum detection equipment supports continuous awareness of nearby aerial activity, while navigation-signal analysis provides reference data for authorized review. The command platform links alerts, map views, operator notes, and response status so the site team can maintain traceable event records and coordinate with established facility procedures.
